name: primitives-headless-popover
title: Headless Popover
blurb: Floating panel scales in from center with spring animation.
description: Headless UI popover with Framer Motion animations. Panel scales and fades in/out with spring physics. Supports backdrop, button, and group composition for managing multiple popovers.
use_when: You need a lightweight, accessible popover with smooth scale animation.
avoid_when: Fixed positioning is needed — this uses absolute positioning anchored to parent.
a11y: Full Headless UI popover accessibility: keyboard navigation, focus management, Escape closes.
